
```jsx
import { CxModal } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxModal from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/modal/CxModal'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **alignment** | Align the modal in the center or top of the screen. | `'top'` \| `'center'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **backdrop** | Apply a backdrop on body while modal is open. | `boolean` \| `'static'` \| `undefined` | true |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **fullscreen** | Set modal to covers the entire user viewport. | `boolean` \| `'small'` \| `'medium'` \| `'large'` \| `'xlarge'` \| `'2xlarge'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **keyboard** | Closes the modal when escape key is pressed. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | true |
| **onClose** | Callback fired when the component requests to be closed. | `(() => void)` \| `undefined` | - |
| **onClosePrevented** | Callback fired when the component requests to be closed. | `(() => void)` \| `undefined` | - |
| **onShow** | Callback fired when the modal is shown, its backdrop is static and a click outside the modal or an escape key press is performed with the keyboard option set to false. | `(() => void)` \| `undefined` | - |
| **portal** | Generates modal using createPortal. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | true |
| **scrollable** | Create a scrollable modal that allows scrolling the modal body. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **size** | Size the component small, large, or extra large. | `'small'` \| `'large'` \| `'xlarge'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **transition** | Remove animation to create modal that simply appear rather than fade in to view. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | true |
| **visible** | Toggle the visibility of modal component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
